title: Grateful Dead Live at Iowa State Fairgrounds on 1973-05-13
lineage: Reel > Apogee Mini ME 24/96> Apogee Mini DAC(monitoring)>Wavelab 5.0(dithered to 16/44)>CD>EAC>Minor Repairs on the GEMS Edit Station>Trac'ed Cdwave Flac'ed level 8 TLH

ai_review.summary: Cleaned‑up soundboard but sounds overly dolbyized with reduced high end; fans still hail the show as a killer performance.
ai_review.review: The two reviewers agree the show itself is strong, with one calling it a “killer SBD.” However, the audio processing is contentious – one reviewer feels the Dolby‑style compression stripped away high frequencies, while another praises the hiss removal and overall cleanliness. The result is a mixed impression of an otherwise solid 1973 performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers note a good show, but they disagree on the recording quality; limited data (only two reviews) leads to low confidence and a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hiss removed, but excessive Dolby‑style processing reduces high‑end detail; some listeners find the sound overly compressed and lacking clarity.
